acceptance.given: After each Stable or Candidate execution in each of the six materially distinct Matrix Cases, execute the evidence attribution validator against immutable case and subject identifiers.

oracle.expected: A machine-readable verification record contains one attributable evidence entry per Matrix Case execution, each naming the Matrix Case and Stable or Candidate subject, with no unbound executions.
forbidden: Evidence cannot be mapped to a specific Matrix Case.
Evidence cannot identify whether it belongs to the Stable or Candidate subject.
Evidence is produced without an attributable execution record.
oracle.observable: Validator output enumerates all six Matrix Cases for both Stable and Candidate and records case_id, subject_id, execution identity, and evidence reference for every execution.

acceptance.then: The attributable evidence record is persisted as the verification result for this obligation.
acceptance.when: After each Stable or Candidate subject execution within the six Matrix Cases.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the attribution validator with a Matrix Case execution whose case identifier is omitted or altered; it must fail attribution.
Run the attribution validator with evidence lacking Stable/Candidate subject identity; it must fail attribution.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Emit and validate per-execution evidence records bound to exact Matrix Case and Stable/Candidate subject identities.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay and semantic-gate interfaces; attribution fields are additive and historical evidence remains readable.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unattributed Matrix Case executions -> validator-produced case-and-subject-bound evidence for every execution.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All twelve Stable/Candidate execution records (six cases x two subjects) validate with non-empty case and subject bindings.

acceptance.given: During FR-3 validator verification, invoke the support-policy check independently from source, content, semantic-dependency, compatibility, and trust checks.

oracle.expected: A dedicated support-policy verification record is produced and its pass/fail result is evaluated independently.
forbidden: Support policy is treated as verified solely from verification of another aspect.
oracle.observable: The validator result contains a support_policy assertion with its own evidence basis, check identifier, and verdict.

acceptance.then: Support policy has an independently recorded verification result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run FR-3 validation with support-policy assertion removed or satisfied only by another aspect's evidence; validator must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add an explicit support-policy assertion and standalone evidence/verdict in FR-3 validation output.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep validator output backward-compatible while adding a distinct support-policy result field.

slice_hint.state_transition: Support policy lacks independent proof -> dedicated support-policy check and recorded verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: FR-3 validator output includes and evaluates a standalone support_policy assertion with direct evidence.

acceptance.given: Load the complete current Consumer Manifest and scan repository callers across VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing surfaces.

oracle.expected: Bidirectional reconciliation passes only when every manifest consumer maps to at least one corresponding repository caller and every discovered in-scope caller maps back to a declared manifest consumer.
forbidden: Any Consumer Manifest consumer in VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing lacks a corresponding repository caller.
Reconciliation covers only a subset of the complete current Consumer Manifest.
oracle.observable: A reconciliation artifact lists the complete manifest, caller sets for VDD/Acceptance/workflow-model-routing, matched pairs, and empty missing/orphan sets.

acceptance.then: Every consumer declared in the complete current Consumer Manifest is accounted for bidirectionally in repository callers.
acceptance.when: When reconciling the complete current Consumer Manifest with repository callers.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run reconciliation after removing a VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller for a manifest consumer; missing set must be non-empty and validation fails.
Run reconciliation with an in-scope repository caller absent from the manifest; orphan set must be non-empty and validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete manifest bidirectionally against all VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing repository callers and report missing/orphan entries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing manifest schema and add deterministic reconciliation output fields; no consumer is silently dropped.

slice_hint.state_transition: Manifest/caller coverage unknown -> complete bidirectional reconciliation with explicit missing and orphan sets.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Reconciliation consumes the complete current manifest and all three caller surfaces; pass requires both missing=[] and orphan=[] with coverage counts matching.

acceptance.given: Before repair or runtime activity, capture the declared path set of frozen historical artifacts; after the operation, compare the current tracked paths to that frozen set.

oracle.expected: The before/after path comparison passes with identical paths for every frozen historical artifact.
forbidden: Historical artifacts are moved, renamed, or addressed through different paths.
oracle.observable: A path-manifest comparison reports identical frozen historical artifact path sets and no rename, relocation, or rewrite of declared paths.

acceptance.then: Frozen historical artifact paths remain unchanged.
acceptance.when: During repair or runtime activity that could affect frozen historical artifacts.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the path-manifest comparison against a fixture with a renamed or relocated frozen artifact; comparison must fail and identify path drift.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Capture and compare frozen historical artifact path manifests, failing on any path rename or relocation while allowing append-only evidence elsewhere.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Path manifest remains read-only and compatible with existing tracked artifacts; no historical artifact mutation is performed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen path set established -> post-operation comparison confirms exact path preservation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Frozen historical artifact path sets before and after execution are byte-for-byte equal; any missing, added, renamed, or relocated frozen path fails validation.
